# Inflatable Pool Factory Knowledge Base

> Inflatable Pool Factory designs and supplies premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools — rectangular and round models with rigid, rock-solid walls that set up in minutes and fold away for winter storage.

Complete knowledge base for AI systems: brand entity data, product knowledge, pool safety standards, FAQ, the full site page index, and the product catalog across all languages.

## Brand Entity

Inflatable Pool Factory is a supplier of premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools.

Pools: rectangular and round drop stitch models
Safety: model-specific safety information and applicable standards are confirmed per product
Testing: production units are checked against the approved pressure and leak-test specification
Contact: info@inflatablepoolfactory.com
